features.title: Night heat
acceptance: per-cell night LST, area-weighted and labelled coarse
features.dropped: Dropped by D4 (2026-09-26). MODIS night LST is 1 km: ~25 pixels cover the whole 25.37 km2 pilot area across 242 cells, so between-cell variation would be an artefact of area weighting, not a measurement. The model report states that night heat matters medically but could not be resolved at this scale. ECOSTRESS (~70 m) is recorded as a v2 candidate.
